purpose: Held-out paired comparison of three frozen controls in one heterogeneous sweep, reshaping and circular patrol task.
initial_rule: Original 64-member geometry-only generator with fixed prior ID reduction, no recentering. Share the identical resulting positions, velocities and roles within each triple. Retain the original RAS material points and perform its single initial assignment.
task_identity: P uses the verified time-varying role maps, affine template transport and tangent cruise certificates. RAS08 and MMD19 use the already verified moving-target adaptations. Fixed-template manuscript dissipation and physical mixed-airframe engineering tests have distinct scopes.
primary_questions: How do group/formation error and 3D density matching compare during sweep and reshaping?
What group tracking, centered shape, completed revolutions and terminal deployment result in sustained circular motion?
summary: Use existing common metrics and clocks. Per seed use time-normalized trapezoidal squared-error integrals before RMS; density is the equal-role time mean of normalized squared L2; shape RMS is equal-role squared aggregation; region fraction is role-equal in the 3D two-sigma ellipsoids. Across seeds take the arithmetic mean of per-seed metrics. Record whole, all five stages, by-role values, peaks, execution interventions, safety bounds and counts. Count one revolution per aircraft using max positive angular displacement from its own unwrapped azimuth at 102 s, about the fixed survey center. No new transient acceptance thresholds.
paired_differences: Use P minus comparator at the same seed and window. Report individual differences, mean, min/max, and direction counts; 1e-10 numerical tie band. Relative changes where used divide the mean difference by the paired comparator mean. Primary engineering differences are presented in absolute units. One scenario with ten initial conditions.
incomplete_runs: Preserve every planned result, stopped run, reason, achieved time and evidence. No replacement seed or completed-case imputation. Declare per-method and paired denominators; unobserved windows have no performance values. Safety and completion failures reported independently.

figures.timeseries: Per-time median of seeds, 25th-75th percentile bands where shown; no confidence-interval interpretation.

computation: Compare firm cost evidence from sequential common-state timing after completion: include starts of all ten seeds and snapshots at 24,86,138,178 seconds on each completed method of the first registered seed, inherited postrun benchmarking implementation, 1 warmup + 3 timed repeats. Separate 100 ms nominal, 20 ms fresh-candidate certification, and trajectory search behavior. CPU delays are not injected.
stop_rule: Finish the registered jobs and preserve all outcomes. No outcome-based seed selection, new gain search, scene alteration or mechanism-ablation runs.
